## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive (Narrow/Weak). SPY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.03%) in RECOVERY ↑ rising and VXX (1W: -7.46% | 1M: -8.49%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling provide mixed confirmations, keeping the regime neutral.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stability: HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.09%) / LQD (1W: +0.15% | 1M: +0.11%) ABOVE TREND → credit stress EASING. Risk sentiment: VXX (1W: -7.46% | 1M: -8.49%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling and GLD (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling signal pockets of risk-off in commodities.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-compressed: UUP (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +2.71%) in CORRECTION and TLT (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +1.17%) ABOVE TREND → yields stable, dollar mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals and semiconductors/biotech leading: XBI (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +15.89%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +12.65%) ABOVE TREND; XLK (1W: +3.44% | 1M: -0.14%) in RECOVERY. Style mixed / no clear leadership given weak breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**
Parity with EM resilience: SPY (1W: +1.80% | 1M: -1.03%) RECOVERY and EEM (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +0.24%) ABOVE TREND, while China FXI (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -9.19%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling remains a regional laggard.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed: ARKK (1W: +5.40% | 1M: -1.38%) RECOVERY and IWM (1W: +1.74% | 1M: +3.70%) ABOVE TREND show speculative risk on, but IBIT (1W: -5.72% | 1M: -20.03%) BELOW TREND signals crypto pullback.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Mixed: CPER (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -2.91%) in RECOVERY ↑ rising while precious metals GLD (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling show broad commodity dispersion.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy weak: XLE (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -4.97%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -19.57%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling, offset by nat-gas UNG (1W: +1.91% | 1M: -1.76%) in RECOVERY.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XBI (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +15.89%) and SOXX (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +12.65%) ABOVE TREND; DIVERGENCE: XLK (RECOVERY) vs XLF (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +4.30%) in CORRECTION and multiple 1W/1M mismatches constitute a MAJOR divergence → transitional market.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to cyclicals/semis/biotech (XLI (1W: +3.97% | 1M: +7.25%) ABOVE TREND, XBI ABOVE TREND, SOXX ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to gold and broad energy (GLD (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND, XLE BELOW TREND); monitor XLK for sustainable follow-through.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XBI (1W: +7.63% | 1M: +15.89%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +6.19% | 1M: +12.65%) ABOVE TREND — favor exposure if momentum holds. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -2.48% | 1M: -4.97%) BELOW TREND and XME (1W: -3.58% | 1M: -14.54%) BELOW TREND — monitor for further weakness.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: UNG (1W: +1.91% | 1M: -1.76%) RECOVERY and CPER (1W: +1.10% | 1M: -2.91%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -2.37% | 1M: -11.68%) BELOW TREND and USO/BNO (USO 1W: -4.33% | 1M: -17.55%; BNO 1W: -4.35% | 1M: -19.57%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 watch for complacency — VXX (1W: -7.46% | 1M: -8.49%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling; HYG/LQD health threshold ~0.80 — HYG (1W: +0.13% | 1M: +0.09%) ABOVE TREND signals stable credit; XLK/XLF gap (monitor XLK (1W: +3.44% | 1M: -0.14%) RECOVERY vs XLF (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +4.30%) CORRECTION) for rotation risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive, mixed signals between risk proxies and weak breadth. Biotech/semis/industrials showing strength (XBI, SOXX, XLI) while major divergence between XLK and XLF is the key risk to monitor.
